tools._comment: Gateway tool-result discipline (B-4). A tool result IS context: bound it, ANNOUNCE the bound so the organ can re-derive instead of assuming it saw everything, and never let a binary file reach a model. An unbounded readFile on a downloaded PDF once pushed a single organ call to 877k input tokens.

versioning._comment: Canonical commit format: v{YYYY}.{MM}.{DD}.{index}.{subindex}: description. This is the FOREVER format. The extractVersion() regex in app/src/app/api/upgrade/route.ts MUST match this. A temporary vX.Y.Z format was used during v5.0-v5.3 and is supported for back-compat only.

workspaces._comment: Canonical workspace directories the daemon reads from. Manifests MUST target these paths.
